So new R5: [0,0,0, 171/14, -3/14, -159/14].

col4: 4 - 9/7 = (28/7 - 9/7)= 19/7.

Now we have matrix:

But careful: The determinant of the original matrix is equal to the product of the diagonal entries of the upper triangular matrix after row operations that only add multiples of rows above, provided we haven't scaled rows.
